surprise.text: The lettuce could not be harvested until a lined basket had been made; inspecting the mesh revealed and automatically made it.

arbitrary.text: Requiring a basket before harvesting was not apparent from the initial board, although its purpose became clear once made.

continue.text: Yes. The practical construction details and the fresh meal's payoff make me curious about what the expedition does next.
